name: progineousgb/local-hour
description: Run a task at the same local clock time for each user, once, including daylight-saving days.

suggest.illuminate/support: ^12.0 || ^13.0. Service provider and facade for Laravel 12 and 13. Not required to run the clock tests.
suggest.illuminate/console: ^12.0 || ^13.0. Artisan command local-hour:run on Laravel 12 and 13.
suggest.illuminate/database: ^12.0 || ^13.0. Chunked Eloquent user reads and the local_hour_runs claim table on Laravel 12 and 13.
